statement: bin/curate/check_regressed_pairs.py:253-262: when the work of a shared case raises, the cache key stays unset and the next thread waiting on it runs the work again, into the directory the first attempt left; the exception reported is then a FileExistsError of the earlier record in list order and not the real cause.  Never a false OK: both forms end in a traceback and exit 1.  One case is shared by two records today.  By reading; 0 of 10 pooled runs with a failure planted in that case showed the substitute.

bin/curate/check_regressed_pairs.py:282 sets CHOUPO_THREADS=1 for the whole process and leaves it set, so every later arm of a pooled run also runs its children on one thread; the docstring says the cap applies to each pooled child.  Outputs are byte-identical either way.
bin/curate/check_regressed_pairs.py:1344 is a dead return after the return at :1343.
CHOUPO_GATE_JOBS set to 0, a negative or a non-number is replaced by the default width with no message (bin/curate/check_regressed_pairs.py:238-242).

One path runs a fetch in-process from a worker thread outside the once-per-case guard (pairs_c283.py:190 reached from bin/curate/check_regressed_pairs.py:1496) and rewrites the case's CHECKLIST.txt; 80 catalogue records take it and none of their cases is shared today.  The docstring's account of what is shared leaves this path out.
The gate leaves gitignored files in the cases it checks (constant/archiveExtracts/, CHECKLIST.txt: 2139 files after the review's runs); not new with the pool.

A worker's exception cancels the futures not yet started and the gate fails; an interrupt mid-pool runs the clean-up and leaves no temporary directory; a kill would leave the temporary directory and up to N engine children (one in the serial form).
sys.path grows by duplicate entries on every call from the worker threads; harmless, and the serial form does the same.

Not the pool's: a pair record that loses its `fittedInCase` line drops out of the scan in silence, since records are selected by the presence of that word (bin/curate/check_regressed_pairs.py:1988), and the floor on the count would not notice one record.  Read by the reviewer and by the reviewing session; not run.
